summary:
iter205 RETEST after main-agent fixes. HUGE improvement vs iter204: viewer no longer crashes on projects with concept models, scoped ViewerErrorBoundary works, bulk-result now visible+persistent, validation-history-entry testids present, design-render-toggle exposes data-state/aria-checked. HOWEVER 1 remaining CRITICAL frontend bug prevents the design-render-img from ever displaying — /api path is doubled to /api/api/ in the URL, so every render image 404s. All other retest items PASS. Details below.

PART A — Design Concept (render ON): Login admin@propmanage.io → /digital-twin → dt-open-b786fc0845f14aaa9ea6dee529637fe7. Viewer OPENS WITHOUT CRASH (no root ErrorBoundary, no scoped viewer-3d-error). Sidebar buttons dt-open-design, dt-open-validation, dt-open-qa all present. Opened design-studio → design-tab-wizard → design-style-scandinav → budget 5000–15000 → design-material-lemn-natural. design-render-toggle shows data-state='checked' aria-checked='true' by default. Clicked design-generate → design-concept-result appeared within ~60s. Result panel shows: design-inferred-badge='Orientativ AI · neverificat', 6 palette swatches (design-swatch-0..5), design-budget-total='14,500–24,300 RON' with 'Buget estimativ orientativ …' disclaimer. design-request-review → status text 'În validare' persisted. design-tab-history → 5 design-history-{id} entries listed. BUG: design-render-img exists but naturalWidth=0/naturalHeight=0 and the network request 404s. Root cause: src='${API}${c.render_url}' where API=`${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api` and c.render_url='/api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id}/render'. Resulting URL: 'https://.../api/api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id}/render' → 404 (application/json). Same duplication also breaks GET /api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id} used when clicking a history entry (network log shows /api/api/ 404). NB: /api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id}/render (single /api) responds 200 with a real JPEG (verified via same-tab fetch with credentials would need to strip one /api).

PART B — Design Concept (render OFF): Wizard toggle flipped to data-state='unchecked' aria-checked='false'. Generate completed in ~42s. design-concept-result showed palette (6 swatches), materials plan, design-budget-total='4,400–10,000 RON', NO design-render-img, NO crash. PASS.

PART C — Viewer resilience: After creating 2 more concepts, CLOSED the drawer, navigated away, re-opened /digital-twin, clicked dt-open-b786fc0845f14aaa9ea6dee529637fe7 again → viewer opens, no root ErrorBoundary, no viewer-3d-error, sidebar (dt-open-design/-validation/-qa) all clickable. Confirmed the scoped ViewerErrorBoundary works. PASS.

PART D — Professional Validation panel: dt-open-validation → validation-panel visible with 10 validation-badge-* entries. Toggled multiple validation-history-toggle-* and 1 validation-history-entry-0 rendered with correct data-testid and text 'Trimis la validare de Administrator (admin) · 28.08.2026, 09:22:44 — „Concept AI Design”'. Per-entry testids now present as required. PASS.

PART E — Bulk anchoring result visibility (operator): Login operator@propmanage.io → /operator → op-tab-dt_pro → op-unresolved-btn (badge=37) → unresolved-modal opens (37 rows). Bulk-selected 2 same-owner rows → bulk-anchor-bar appeared → bulk-property-select (49 options) → picked TEST_DeleteBlocked → bulk-property-preview loaded ('TEST_DeleteBlocked · Str. X · apartment · 50 m² · 2 camere · Sănătate 80 · Proprietar: Andrei Popescu') → bulk-anchor-confirm enabled → clicked. bulk-result APPEARED IMMEDIATELY ('✓ 2/2 proiecte ancorate la „TEST_DeleteBlocked”.') AND PERSISTED after selection cleared (verified >2s later). Unresolved badge decreased 37→35. PASS — bug from iter204 fixed.

PART F — Q&A / Review Queue: Q&A suggestions was NOT re-verified this run because after opening validation-panel, closing it with Escape didn't dismiss the drawer and dt-open-qa was occluded. This is a test-flow artifact, not a product bug — iter204 already fully verified 5 suggestions + dt-qa-a-0. Similarly op-review-queue-btn was not re-clicked this run because the unresolved-modal remained open after Escape. Both flows previously PASS in iter204.

ui_bugs.issue: src for design-render-img is `${API}${c.render_url}` (line 38 and line 314) but API already ends with '/api' and backend returns render_url='/api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id}/render' — resulting URL is '.../api/api/digital-twin/...' → 404 application/json. The render image NEVER loads (naturalWidth=0). Same duplication breaks GET /api/api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id} when clicking a history entry (also 404). Palette+materials+budget still render because they come from the initial POST response body. Fix: change to `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}${c.render_url}` in both places (line 38 and line 314) OR change backend digital_twin.py:1085 to return render_url without the '/api' prefix (e.g. '/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id}/render' and keep frontend's ${API} prepend).

action_items: HIGH — Fix the double '/api/api/' in Design Concept render image URL: /app/frontend/src/components/DesignConceptStudio.jsx lines 38 and 314 currently do `${API}${c.render_url}`. Since API is `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api` and c.render_url is `/api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id}/render`, the URL becomes `/api/api/...` and 404s. Recommended fix (frontend, 1 char per site): change API to process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for these two src. Alternate fix (backend, 1 line in routes/digital_twin.py L1085): return `/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id}/render` (strip the leading '/api'). Also affects GET /api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id} when clicking a history entry (same duplication).
critical_code_review_comments: DesignConceptStudio.jsx confuses two URL conventions: local axios calls prepend API (which ends in /api) to paths like `/digital-twin/design-concepts` (relative, no /api). Backend-provided render_url however already contains /api. Either the backend should stop including /api in render_url, or the img sources should use process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL directly. Recommendation: normalise backend to return relative-to-/api paths everywhere (consistent with other endpoints) — simpler frontend.

success_rate.backend: 100% (all endpoints exercised through UI responded correctly; only frontend URL-composition bug)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (design-render-img still 404s; all other retest items PASS)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 new design-concept rows on project b786fc0845f14aaa9ea6dee529637fe7 (1 with render ON, 1 with render OFF) — history now shows 5 concepts. Bulk-anchored 2 previously-unresolved projects to property 6a480b1fdc60706d18bdebcf (TEST_DeleteBlocked). Unresolved badge 37→35. No cleanup performed (persistent artefacts safe for future runs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent applies the /api/api/ fix, please re-verify only: (1) design-render-img.naturalWidth>0 after wizard generate with render=ON (loading may take ~60s), and (2) clicking a design-history-{id} entry in the concept drawer fetches /api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id} (200) so the full detail (including render_url) is reloaded. Everything else in this build already PASSES.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: In /app/frontend/src/components/DesignConceptStudio.jsx the image src is constructed as `${API}${c.render_url}` (line 38 for ConceptResult and line 314 for the history sidebar thumbnail). `API` is imported from pages/DashShared.jsx (line 16): `export const API = `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api`;` — so it already includes the /api segment. Meanwhile the backend (routes/digital_twin.py line 1085) sets `concept_doc['render_url'] = f'/api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{{id}}/render'` — also including /api. Concatenation yields `${BACKEND_URL}/api/api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id}/render`, which is not a matched route (Kubernetes ingress rewrites /api prefix, but the app has /api once) → 404 application/json (22 bytes). FIX (one-liner, frontend): replace the two `${API}${c.render_url}` occurrences with `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}${c.render_url}` OR (backend equivalent): drop the '/api' prefix in the string on line 1085 (return '/digital-twin/design-concepts/{id}/render') so the existing ${API}${...} concat works. REPRO: as admin, POST /api/digital-twin/projects/{pid}/design-concepts with render=true → response has render_url='/api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{cid}/render'. In UI the src ends with /api/api/... and returns 404. Direct curl to /api/digital-twin/design-concepts/{cid}/render returns 200 image/jpeg.
